label: H3 Live Action - Continuous Bilateral Combat 8s
useWhen: two human characters exchange several weighted attacks without resetting pose
the shot must breathe longer than a five-second isolated signature unit
continuity should be carried by one uninterrupted action and an active cut

durationContract.rule: one uninterrupted long take with both fighters attacking, defending, being displaced and recovering

geometryContract.reason: matches the owner-approved H3 8-second action route and keeps latent dimensions model-safe

required: approved dynamic first and last anchors with SHA-256 and approval scope
identity and combat-identity matrices for both fighters
three temporal intervals with reciprocal physical exchanges
ground-contact explanation for every grounded body translation
active cut strategy that does not require a generated five-second patch
controlContract.intermediateAnchor: forbidden inside uninterrupted bilateral melee because a forced future impact pose can pull the reaction before contact
controlContract.motion: prompt-guided between two dynamic boundaries; bind the moving end anchor to final frame 191 and require useful body, camera, cloth and environmental motion through that frame

forbidden: MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo mixed into the FL2VA graph
unmotivated hovering or rigid ground sliding
camera shake, RIFE or Foley used to counterfeit impact
RIFE or upscale before source approval

promptContract.language: English except original dialogue and visible text
promptContract.timelineRule: Begin with ONE UNINTERRUPTED EIGHT-SECOND; write reciprocal action over 0-30%, 30-70% and 70-100%, with useful motion through the last frame.
promptContract.causalityRule: For every hit: load and propulsion occur first, visible contact occurs next, defender compression and center-of-mass travel begin only after contact, then both recover.
promptContract.groundingRule: Every grounded translation is visibly paid for by stepping, pivoting, skidding with a furrow, rolling or being dragged; every airborne arc starts with visible propulsion or post-contact launch and ends with a landing.
promptContract.bilateralRule: Both fighters attack, block or evade and regain initiative; no polite turn-taking, passive target or one-sided pose sequence.
promptContract.junctionRule: End during a dynamic camera/body vector suitable for a direct match-on-action, occlusion cut or whip-pan cut; never rebuild pose in a connector.
promptContract.readabilityRule: Keep contact and foot support readable; do not hide causal beats with effects, framing, shake or debris.
